_meta.folk: Machine form of TEXT_BIBLE.md. Read that file for the law before changing a string.
_meta._schema: {key: {folk, church, state, numb1?, numb2?, numb3?}}. null = this register has no word for this thing (deliberate absence). Omitted numb1/2/3 = this key does not degrade. "" at a numb step = the line is not shown at that step. {n}/{name} are runtime substitutions.
_meta._authority: design_system/v1_0_threejs_soulslike/DECISIONS.md D6 (naming) + PRD R14 (polyphonic text). Lore: docs/lore/.

item.weapon.hearth_iron.desc.folk: The fire iron from Anna's hearth. Black at the tip, warm halfway up.
item.weapon.hearth_iron.desc.church: What kept her fire is carried out into the cold.
item.weapon.hearth_iron.desc.state: Household implement in unsanctioned use. Log on entry.
item.weapon.hearth_iron.desc.numb1: The fire iron from Anna's hearth.
item.weapon.hearth_iron.desc.numb2: Fire iron. Taken from the cabin.

item.weapon.hearth_iron.lore.folk: It was for banking coals. It banks nothing now.
item.weapon.hearth_iron.lore.church: A tool of warmth taken up for a harder warmth.

item.tincture.vial.desc.folk: Doses drawn for Anna. They are yours now, and they are counted. {n} left.
item.tincture.vial.desc.church: What was prepared for one is spent by another.
item.tincture.vial.desc.state: E-3 stabilizer. Doses on hand: {n}. Replenish at Warming Station.

item.tincture.vial.lore.folk: Borrowed mercy. Renewed at the fire, never repaid.
item.tincture.vial.lore.church: Mercy is carried, and only so far.

item.tincture.pulseleaf_draught.desc.folk: Bitter and quick. Closes the wound before you have finished flinching.

item.tincture.pulseleaf_draught.lore.folk: The plants the old world named for the molecules they replaced.

item.tincture.honeyed_draw.desc.folk: Slow and sweet. Keeps working while you keep moving.
item.tincture.honeyed_draw.desc.state: Extended release. Effect continues through activity.

item.tincture.honeyed_draw.lore.folk: Honey keeps. That is most of what he knows about honey.

item.tincture.salt_wash.desc.folk: Stings badly enough to be believed. Drives the Turn back out of you.
item.tincture.salt_wash.desc.church: The Withering is washed out; it is not argued with.
item.tincture.salt_wash.desc.state: Clears accumulated affect flattening. Index returns toward baseline.
item.tincture.salt_wash.desc.numb1: Stings. Drives the Turn back out of you.

item.tincture.salt_wash.lore.folk: Salt was in the pouch before any of the rest of it.
item.tincture.salt_wash.lore.church: Salt of the covenant; it keeps what it touches.
item.tincture.salt_wash.lore.numb1: Salt was in the pouch first.

item.tincture.cedar_wool_compress.desc.folk: Heat held against the chest. Your breath comes back and your feet hold.
item.tincture.cedar_wool_compress.desc.state: Restores exertion tolerance. Brief postural stability gain.
item.tincture.cedar_wool_compress.desc.numb1: Heat on the chest. Breath comes back.

item.tincture.cedar_wool_compress.lore.folk: Cedar lasts. Somebody told him that once and he never checked.

item.tincture.bitter_phrine.desc.folk: Takes the whole wound. Then your hands are not yours for a while.
item.tincture.bitter_phrine.desc.state: High-dose. Substantial recovery. Instability window follows administration.
item.tincture.bitter_phrine.desc.numb1: Takes the whole wound. Hands go unsteady after.

item.tincture.bitter_phrine.lore.folk: Everything that works this well costs the same way.

item.ember.desc.folk: One swallow and the grey stone turns to smoke. {n} left.
item.ember.desc.church: It burns. It was not given.
item.ember.desc.state: E-7. Units on hand: {n}. Self-administration is within protocol.
item.ember.desc.numb1: One swallow and the grey stone turns to smoke. {n} left.

item.ember.lore.folk: A fire he had not been given.
item.ember.lore.numb1: A fire he had not been given.

item.pouch.pulseleaf.desc.folk: Small leaves at the base of a stone, with a bitter shimmer if you know how to read it.

item.pouch.pulseleaf.lore.folk: Named for the molecule it replaced.

item.pouch.arbor.desc.folk: Shaved inner bark, dried grey. Loosens what is clenched.

item.pouch.arbor.lore.folk: Grows where the old orchards went back to woods.

item.pouch.acebark.desc.folk: Chewed for fever. Tastes like a fence post and works anyway.

item.pouch.acebark.lore.folk: The first thing anyone learns to gather.

item.pouch.phrine.desc.folk: Kept in dark glass. A little wakes a heart; more than a little does not.
item.pouch.phrine.desc.state: Pressor analogue. Narrow margin. Two-person check advised.

item.pouch.phrine.lore.folk: He has never used it on someone who then walked.

item.pouch.cillin.desc.folk: The good powder. He is always out and always looking.

item.pouch.cillin.lore.folk: Worth more than the coat it is carried in.

item.pouch.zyl.desc.folk: Numbs the skin so the hands can work. Does not reach any deeper.

item.pouch.zyl.lore.folk: The honest kind of numb: it stops where it says it stops.

item.pouch.honey.desc.folk: In waxed cloth. Dresses a burn and carries a bitter dose past the tongue.
item.pouch.honey.desc.church: Given to the sick and to the child, and it keeps without asking.
item.pouch.honey.desc.state: Wound dressing, occlusive. Carrier for oral administration.

item.pouch.honey.lore.folk: The only thing in the pouch that does not spoil.
item.pouch.honey.lore.church: It does not spoil; neither does what it stands for.

item.pouch.cedar.name.church: the wood that does not rot

item.pouch.cedar.desc.folk: Shavings and a strip of bark. Smells like a hope chest.
item.pouch.cedar.desc.church: Cut for the temple and for the coffin alike.

item.pouch.cedar.lore.folk: Cedar lasts. His son knew that before he did.
item.pouch.cedar.lore.church: It outlasts the hand that shaped it.

item.pouch.wool.desc.folk: Greasy and warm even wet. Packs a wound, holds a compress.
item.pouch.wool.desc.church: Warmth taken from the animal and given to the sick.
item.pouch.wool.desc.state: Absorbent packing. Retains thermal value when saturated.

item.pouch.wool.lore.folk: Wet wool is the smell of every November he can remember.

item.pouch.cotton.desc.folk: Boiled, folded, counted. The one thing he still keeps in numbers.
item.pouch.cotton.desc.church: The cloth is made clean before it is laid on anyone.
item.pouch.cotton.desc.state: Sterile field material. Count on open, count on close.
item.pouch.cotton.desc.numb2: Field material. Count on open and close.

item.pouch.cotton.lore.folk: Count them in, count them out. That much of the hospital stayed.

item.pouch.salt.desc.folk: For the wash and for the road. Everything here has salt on it by December.
item.pouch.salt.desc.church: Laid on the tongue at the door, before anything else is said.

item.pouch.salt.lore.folk: Road salt and wound salt out of the same sack, and he knows it.

item.pouch.myrrh.desc.folk: Resin beads, dark red. Cuts a smell no washing will.
item.pouch.myrrh.desc.church: Brought to the tomb by women who expected to use it.
item.pouch.myrrh.desc.state: Aromatic resin. Odour management, post-mortem handling.

item.pouch.myrrh.lore.folk: He carries it for the living and uses it for the dead.
item.pouch.myrrh.lore.church: It is for the body after the breath.

item.pouch.oil.desc.folk: A flat tin of it. Loosens a bandage, softens a hand, thins a salve.
item.pouch.oil.desc.church: Poured on the forehead of the one who cannot ask for it.

item.pouch.oil.lore.folk: He has used it both ways and only writes down one of them.
item.pouch.oil.lore.church: It is asked for by the Church and given by the hand.

item.pouch.furos.desc.folk: Small dark glass, hoarded since the last town. Pulls water off a drowning chest.

item.pouch.furos.lore.folk: It buys a night. Sometimes a night is the whole ask.

item.loot.wolf_hide.desc.folk: Heavy, rank, still warm at the shoulder. It will wrap a haft or a chest.

item.loot.wolf_hide.lore.folk: You took the door from it. Now you are wearing the door.

item.loot.wolf_sinew.desc.folk: Dried, it binds tighter than any cord he can trade for.

item.loot.wolf_sinew.lore.folk: What held the animal together will hold the iron on.

item.loot.wolf_tooth.desc.folk: Longer than it looked when it was coming at you.
item.loot.wolf_tooth.desc.state: Recovered animal material. Minor fabrication stock.

item.loot.wolf_tooth.lore.folk: Nothing about it is a trophy. It is just what was in the way.

item.loot.wolf_meat.desc.folk: Dark and stringy. It is food, and the boy has not eaten today.
item.loot.wolf_meat.desc.state: Recovered animal protein. Cook thoroughly. Not for issue.

item.loot.wolf_meat.lore.folk: Loot is not winning. It is what is left over from a thing that happened.

item.charm.cedar_dog.name.church: the dog that went with them

item.charm.cedar_dog.desc.folk: Carved by a smaller hand than his. The ear is uneven and the flank has a knife mark.
item.charm.cedar_dog.desc.church: It walked out and it walked back, and no one wrote down why.
item.charm.cedar_dog.desc.numb1: Carved by a smaller hand than his. The ear is uneven.

item.charm.cedar_dog.lore.folk: Pine, he told the boy. The boy insisted on cedar, because cedar lasts.
item.charm.cedar_dog.lore.church: A companion given for a journey no one explained.
item.charm.cedar_dog.lore.numb1: Pine, he told the boy. The boy insisted on cedar.

item.key.wardens_tag.name.church: the name that outlived the post

item.key.wardens_tag.desc.folk: Stamped tin, warm from his belt. There is a name on it.
item.key.wardens_tag.desc.church: One name among the tags he hung on the line.
item.key.wardens_tag.desc.state: Post identification, recovered. File on return to station.
item.key.wardens_tag.desc.numb1: Stamped tin. There is a name on it.
item.key.wardens_tag.desc.numb3: Post ID recovered. File on return.

item.key.wardens_tag.lore.folk: He kept the line after there was no one left to keep it for.
item.key.wardens_tag.lore.church: The lamp stayed lit after the asking died.
item.key.wardens_tag.lore.numb1: He kept the line after there was no one left to keep it for.

item.key.notebook.desc.folk: Leather, swollen with damp. Names in graphite, one to a line.
item.key.notebook.desc.church: The commemoration, carried on the body.
item.key.notebook.desc.state: Non-standard personal register. Names recorded without case reference.
item.key.notebook.desc.numb1: Leather, swollen with damp. Names in graphite.
item.key.notebook.desc.numb2: Personal register. Names, no case references.

item.key.notebook.lore.folk: The virus could take the breath. It could not plunder the name.
item.key.notebook.lore.church: What is written here is read elsewhere.
item.key.notebook.lore.numb1: It could not plunder the name.

item.key.open_page.desc.folk: Loose unwritten leaves, scattered where you fell. Go back for them.
item.key.open_page.desc.church: What you witnessed and did not write waits at the place.
item.key.open_page.desc.state: Unfiled outcomes held at incident site. One retrieval permitted.
item.key.open_page.desc.numb1: Loose leaves where you fell. Go back for them.
item.key.open_page.desc.numb2: Loose leaves at the site. One retrieval.
item.key.open_page.desc.numb3: Unfiled outcomes at site. One retrieval.

item.key.open_page.lore.folk: Die again on the way and they are lost to the spreadsheet.
item.key.open_page.lore.church: The unnamed are not lost. They are only unwritten here.
item.key.open_page.lore.numb1: Die again on the way and they are gone.

item.key.gate_pin.desc.folk: A bent iron pin off a warden's gate. It opens the road back the short way.
item.key.gate_pin.desc.state: Recovered gate hardware. Restores post-road transit.
item.key.gate_pin.desc.numb2: Gate hardware. Opens the short way back.

item.key.gate_pin.lore.folk: Someone walked this loop every day for years. Now you do.

npc.birdie.attrib.church: the fool who keeps the road

boss.warden.attrib.church: the lamp that stayed lit after the asking died

npc.anna.water.folk: Just the wet on my lip. Don't spend it all on me.

npc.anna.dose_first.folk: Is that the last of it?

npc.anna.about_iiro.folk: He's been carrying that cup since morning. He won't set it down.

npc.anna.presence.observe_breath.folk: (Her breath goes long, then short, then long. Nothing you do changes the count.)

npc.anna.presence.sit_near.folk: Sit where I can see you.

npc.anna.presence.hold_hand.folk: Cold hands. Good for a fever.

npc.anna.presence.pray.folk: I don't know the words either. Say them anyway.

npc.anna.presence.keep_watch.folk: (She does not speak. The hearth does.)

npc.anna.presence.witness_death.folk: Anna's breath stops with Kalev still beside her.

npc.anna.presence.write_name.folk: (You write Anna. The graphite shines darkly in the damp.)

npc.iiro.bread_receive.folk: Half's enough. Is she having some?

npc.iiro.water_carry.folk: I can carry it. I won't spill it.

npc.iiro.cabin_fear.folk: Is she asleep, or is it the other thing?

npc.iiro.flight_start.folk: I know the way. Past the stump, then the two turns.

npc.iiro.flight_mid.folk: I'm at the stump! Don't come — hold it there!

npc.iiro.flight_wounded.folk: It got my leg. I'm still going.

npc.iiro.flight_woodline.folk: I'm in the trees. I'm in the trees.

npc.iiro.silence_after.folk: (Iiro says nothing. He holds the cup with both hands.)

npc.birdie.first_sight.folk: You walk loud for someone on his own.

npc.birdie.follow.folk: I'm not following you. I'm going the same way.

npc.birdie.name_refusal.folk: Names are for people who know where they came from.

npc.birdie.road_ahead.folk: That road bends toward Bethany. I've never been. I'm still going.

notebook.anna_choice_b.folk: Anna. The breath went out with me still there.

notebook.anna_choice_c.folk: Anna. She asked whether the boy had eaten.

notebook.borrowed_mercy.folk: The doses were hers. I am walking on them.

notebook.bread.folk: Bread, halved. It was what there was.

notebook.warden_tag.folk: Arvo Lampi. He kept the line after there was no one left to keep it for.

notebook.warden_tag_unwritten.folk: (A tin tag in the pouch. The border keeps an unwritten mark.)

notebook.page_66_locked.folk: (Page sixty-six is spoken for. Seven lines down, in his own hand.)

notebook.page_77_reserved.folk: (Page seventy-seven. A faint gold rule, seven lines down. Nothing on it.)

ui.hearth.numbness_restore.folk: Some of the words came back.
ui.hearth.numbness_restore.numb1: Some of the words came back.

ui.death.open_page_dropped.folk: Your Names lie where you fell.
ui.death.open_page_dropped.church: The unnamed wait at the place.
ui.death.open_page_dropped.state: Unfiled outcomes held at incident site.
ui.death.open_page_dropped.numb1: Your Names lie where you fell.

ui.recovery.respawn.folk: The fire held. You did not.
ui.recovery.respawn.church: You are returned to the lamp.
ui.recovery.respawn.numb1: The fire held. You did not.

ui.recovery.enemies_returned.folk: The wood filled back in behind you.

ui.burden.line.church: The weight is not the enemy.
ui.burden.line.state: Load band determines permitted evasive class.
ui.burden.line.numb3: Load band determines permitted evasive class.

ui.attend.lost.church: Out of sight, not out of mind.
ui.attend.lost.state: Focus lost. Subject out of range.
ui.attend.lost.numb3: Focus lost. Subject out of range.

ui.ember.numbness_gained.folk: Something goes quiet that was not quiet before.
ui.ember.numbness_gained.numb1: Something goes quiet that was not quiet before.

ui.world.gate_opened.folk: The gate swings. The way back is short now.
ui.world.gate_opened.numb1: The gate swings. Short way back.

ui.world.shortcut_opened.folk: You can come back this way.
ui.world.shortcut_opened.numb1: You can come back this way.

ui.world.snare_rooted.folk: The line has you. The tags are ringing.
ui.world.snare_rooted.state: Contact with post line. Movement restricted.
ui.world.snare_rooted.numb1: The line has you. Tags ringing.
ui.world.snare_rooted.numb3: Contact with post line. Movement restricted.

boss.aftermath.tag_read.folk: The tag reads ARVO LAMPI. Below it, POST 9.
boss.aftermath.tag_read.church: A name, stamped in tin, on a line he strung himself.
boss.aftermath.tag_read.state: Post identification recovered: LAMPI, A. Post 9.
boss.aftermath.tag_read.numb1: The tag reads ARVO LAMPI. Below it, POST 9.
boss.aftermath.tag_read.numb3: Post ID recovered: LAMPI, A., post 9.

boss.aftermath.written_line.folk: Arvo Lampi. He kept the line after there was no one left to keep it for.

boss.aftermath.walked_away.folk: The tag stays in your pouch. The border keeps the mark unwritten.
boss.aftermath.walked_away.church: One name still uncommemorated, and it is on you.
boss.aftermath.walked_away.numb1: The tag stays in your pouch. The mark stays unwritten.

boss.aftermath.hearth_lit.folk: The clearing has a fire in it now.
boss.aftermath.hearth_lit.church: A lamp where the lamp went out.
boss.aftermath.hearth_lit.numb1: The clearing has a fire in it now.

boss.aftermath.turn_cleansed.state: Filing returns the index to baseline.
